issues.message: The right torso edge ends in dark clothing at (35,41) and the sash ends at (36,42), with background at (36,41), (37,41), and (37,42) beside the diagonal blade. This leaves the waist border open beneath the sleeve. Restore a one-pixel dark contour at (36,41) and (37,42), following the adjacent contour at (37,40); preserve the remaining air gap between body and blade so the draw stays readable.
